ShortDescription.Value: Easily adjust ALL Speed Limits for: road, rail, water, Invisible roads, and Bike/Paths.

Publish.LongDescription:
## Adjust All Speed Limits ...and Invisible roads and Paths now too 🥳
自由调整全路网限速，隐形道路也能改！ 中文详情见下方 ↓
Is a powerful, easy toolkit to fine-tune how fast vehicles travel on any network type.
Open ASL, then click a road or any network to open the full panel.
## 🌄 Key Features
* **Adjust speeds on individual segments** with a simple click. * **Click-and-drag** over the road/track to modify multiple segments at once. * Works on: * 🚗 **Roads** 🚊 **Trams** 🚆 **Trains** 🚇 **Subway** ⛵ **Waterways** 🚲 **New: Bike + Mixed paths** * 👁 **New: Invisible networks** — see/edit invisible hidden roads and bike paths. Optional hotkey works even with the panel closed. * Whole-city speed: Change speeds for entire road groups or rail types at once. * Stats are light: only runs when the panel is open, better data than the game's info panel.
### Bonus Features
- **Paths tab:** Adjust bicycle and pedestrian path limits citywide. Individual bike path edits override the citywide slider. Due to the game's lane structure, pedestrian-only paths can only be adjusted citywide. - **Options menu:** Optional bicycle and scooter vehicle speeds. OFF by default to avoid any potential conflicts with other vehicle-speed mods. - **Options menu:** Personal vehicle statistics (cars + bikes), migrated from the retired Bikes + Paths mod.
## Important
* Remove old "Road Speed Adjuster" (RSA) mod before installing this (modder retired). * Existing custom speeds should remain and can be edited/reset per segment in new mod. * Path limits do not change citizen walking speed. * Remove Bikes + Paths mod (retired) when using ASL; no reset is required. * Vehicles are limited by their model type max speeds as well. This mod is for the Networks themselves, but in Options you can adjust Bicycle vehicles. * **Safe to uninstall:** Customized network speed limits remain. To restore game defaults, use the Reset buttons and save your city before uninstalling. * Lightweight: stats only run while ASL is open. Citywide path changes apply on request or city load, then go idle. * ICE-3 trains have a real top speed of 320km/h, so the rail slider allows up to 400km/h (800km/h with doubled display). * The game's Unlimited highway policy is 200km/h normally, or 400km/h with "Show Game Doubled Speeds".
## Support and Feedback * Support by clicking the LIKE 👍 button (top right). No donations requested. It takes weeks and months to make these level of mods and many hours with testers. * For feedback, use the [Discord](https://discord.gg/gwXgvtyhjc) | [Github](https://github.com/River-Mochi/CS2-AllSpeedLimits). PRs are welcome, GPL-3.0 license. [Forum](https://forum.paradoxplaza.com/forum/threads/adjust-all-speed-limits.1933054/)
## ❤️ Credits and Special Thanks Huge appreciation hugs and waves to everyone
* River-mochi: mod author * Chaosfun: testing and [video of older version](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=qADctjYS5-w) before Invisible roads and paths were added. * Sunny Scunny, Maestro, Gagaxm, Obelix: testing and feedback. * yenayang: technical advisor * Thanks to everyone who tested, supported, or guided development along the way! * Thumbnail photo: Toronto, Canada by [Alex Smith free use Unsplash license](https://unsplash.com/photos/time-lapse-photography-of-vehicles-in-busy-road-sRTLpqB5haw) * Thumbnail: [dog by Joe Caione, free use Unsplash](https://unsplash.com/photos/shallow-focus-photography-of-white-shih-tzu-puppy-running-on-the-grass-qO-PIF84Vxg) * History and thanks to all past modders: SwiftCobra creator of the first speed mod (MIT license). It passed to Aberro's mod (MIT) and then to DanielVNZ's version (retired).

### 全路网限速调整
自由调整城市中各类道路和交通线路的限速！
打开 ASL，点击任意道路即可进入操作面板。支持简体中文界面和提示。
### 🌄 主要功能
- **单击选择路段，拖动批量选择。** 轻松修改限速。 - 🚗 **道路** 🚊 **有轨电车** 🚆 **铁路** 🚇 **地铁** ⛵ **航道** 🚲 **自行车道** - 👁 **隐形道路：** 显示并修改隐形道路和自行车道。在模组选项中设置快捷键，无需打开 ASL 面板即可显示隐形路网。
### 附加功能
- **路径标签页：** 全城调整自行车道和人行道限速。自行车道单独设置的限速优先于全城滑块。受游戏路网机制限制，纯人行道仅支持全城调整。 - **游戏选项菜单（ESC）：** 可调整自行车和电动滑板车速度。默认关闭，以避免与其他车辆速度模组产生潜在冲突。 - **游戏选项菜单：** 个人车辆统计（汽车和自行车），来自已停止维护的 Bikes + Paths 模组。
### 使用须知
- 如已安装旧模组 Road Speed Adjuster（RSA），请先卸载（去年已停止维护）。 - 如已安装 Bikes + Paths 模组，请卸载，所有功能已整合至 ASL。 - 车辆实际速度仍受车型最高速度限制。 - **可安全卸载。** 已修改的路段限速会保留。如需恢复原版限速，请使用重置按钮并保存城市。 - **轻量高效：** 统计仅在面板打开时运行，路径限速调整完成后即休眠。
### ❤️ 支持与反馈
欢迎点击右上角的 👍 点赞支持！免费分享，无需捐款。
问题反馈：[Discord](https://discord.gg/gwXgvtyhjc) | [GitHub](https://github.com/River-Mochi/CS2-AllSpeedLimits) | [Forum](https://forum.paradoxplaza.com/forum/threads/adjust-all-speed-limits.1933054/)
